title: CatPlot: browser-local multi-technique spectroscopy analysis and plotting workbench
description: CatPlot is a pure-static, browser-local workbench for XRD, Raman, FTIR and XPS data. It provides native JCAMP-DX and Bruker UXD import, background subtraction, peak detection, multi-model peak fitting, batch trends, reference-pattern tracks, project archives and publication-oriented PNG/SVG/CSV/HTML export. Raw data remain local and are not uploaded. The release includes public example spectra with provenance and license metadata, deterministic model tests, real-format acceptance fixtures, browser end-to-end tests and SVG/layout visual regression baselines.
